rank_data — IMGMETRICS iqa op

• Data kinds: any → any

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.rank_data(x) -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import iqatid; iqatid.rank_data(x) -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsimgmetrics.get("rank_data"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

平均順位(1 始まり)。同順位は同じ値の順位の平均(scipy.stats.rankdata の 'average' と同じ定義)。

例: [10, 20, 20, 30] → [1, 2.5, 2.5, 4]。±inf は最大 / 最小の順位(互いに同順位)。Raises ValueError: 長さ 2 未満・nan。
